result:
All verified. Now the FOLLOW_UPS.md one-liner for anything noticed outside scope — nothing extraneous was found, so nothing to add. Diff is minimal and complete.

**What was wrong:** `config.py` read all required credentials (`SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) via `os.getenv(..., "")` with no validation anywhere, so a deployment missing these creds would boot successfully and degrade silently into an empty/broken product (Supabase client never constructed, Anthropic calls failing downstream) instead of crashing — violating the standing rule that missing config must raise loudly.

**What changed:** Added `REQUIRED_SETTINGS` and `validate_startup_config()` to `backend/src/core/config.py`, which raises `RuntimeError` listing missing vars when `ENVIRONMENT != "development"`. Wired it into a FastAPI `@app.on_event("startup")` hook in `backend/src/api/routes.py` (not import-time), so it fires when the real server boots but not during pytest collection/import, matching the CI-safety lesson from S1-1. Added `backend/tests/test_startup_config_validation.py` (3 cases: raises outside dev when missing, silent in dev, silent when complete).

**What could regress:** Any deployment that sets `ENVIRONMENT` to something other than `development` (e.g. `production`, `staging`) while genuinely missing one of the three required vars will now fail to start instead of running degraded — this is the intended behavior, but if any environment currently relies on running without these creds (e.g. a staging box intentionally without Supabase), it will now crash at startup and needs `ENVIRONMENT=development` or the creds set.
